name: local-video
description: Short videos made on the PC: Wan2GP (deepbeepmeep, for small GPUs) run headless, LTX-Video distilled by default, with an 8 GB profile (model parts loaded as needed). Text-to-video and 'Animate this' (image-to-video) in Settings > Creations. Without it, video falls back to Higgsfield when its key is set.
license: Wan2GP: see its LICENSE.txt (free for local use); LTX-Video: LTXV Open Weights licence; Wan 2.x Apache-2.0
install: Install (here) or: python tools/setup_extras.py local-video. Needs git and an NVIDIA GPU; makes its own Python venv in harness_data/tools/Wan2GP (about 5 GB, then the model with the first video).
